name: pickle-of-model-or-response-io
attack_scenario: An attacker poisons the embedding/response cache with a pickle whose __reduce__ returns os.system('...'); when the app pickle.loads it, the payload runs.
negative_test_hint: feed the cache loader a pickle whose __reduce__ returns "os.system('touch /tmp/pwned')" and assert the bytes are rejected or the file never appears

exemplar.compliant: cached = json.loads(response.content)  # JSON has no code-execution gadget path
exemplar.explanation: pickle.load(s) on model output, cached embeddings, or a network response deserializes attacker-influencable bytes; pickle executes __reduce__ during unpickling, so a poisoned cache entry or malicious upstream response is arbitrary code execution.
